B0_COVERAGE_CONTRACT.derivation_note: annex A-coverage (coverage_control: topic_order, protocol-class matrix, palace-blocking rules, visibility tags, digest gates, stop conditions) was not supplied. This contract is derived from the charter's protocol section (B0-B5, P6, RT), from B3's named topics, and from the run's own role map; the derivation is flagged in 14_gap_report and in 11_dependency_assumptions (A-008). The 25-batch count required by law 29 is met by this decomposition.
palace_blocking_rules: B1 must resolve all core roles before any palace block runs
a palace block may not start before its B2 dependency chain root (palace 1 -> 4 -> 7; palace 2 -> 3 -> 6 -> 9; palace 8 -> 9) has been emitted
the centre block (5) requires palace 3, because the chart's only centre edge runs there
palace_dependency_chains: 1 -> 4 -> 7 (axis relation R002 and the 4-7 trace R006)
3 -> 5 (lodging spur R004); centre has no other edge
forbidden_scope: reading the chart source after the board card exists (law 44)
inventing a platform, a price, a date, a metric value or a named person
using positional array adjacency as a relation (law 11)

eligible_scope.note: palace 0 is the chart-level block (pillars, zhi_fu, zhi_shi, solar term, system metadata)

digest_gates: 6000 characters per palace block; truncation must be flagged
an ID list is not a digest: value, role, grounding and visibility are inlined
contradiction evidence stays VISIBLE and ELIGIBLE (law 28)
stop_conditions: core role BLOCKED -> halt at B1
fingerprint mismatch at a phase boundary -> SOURCE_CHANGED, halt
ledger does not balance -> B5 cannot close, render PARTIAL + gap report
call budget 60 exhausted -> render PARTIAL + gap report
topic_order: T5 child axis (stem pairs within one palace)
T7 pattern register (markers and their classes)

batches.topic: ledger closure per palace and per batch
citation ledger, closure proof, gap register
red-team pass over every live claim's candidate set
rank status folding and residual uncertainty
